scope: Targeted museum and auction follow-up after the complete MedalBook/TDV crosswalk

results.new_evidence: SALT result exposes exact object metadata and confirms two JPEG files, but both are Local Access. MedalBook has an explicit image-empty page. No eligible complete public image was found in this bounded search.
TDV search result again identifies the 1277/1860–61 silver medal. No independently identified complete image of the formal silver award was found; the SALT bronze trial/badge remains excluded.

decision: Do not substitute the 1892 Yemen medal, a generic undated Yemen medal, the 192 px SALT thumbnail, or the bronze Zaptiye trial/badge. Continue with new bounded museum/auction sources only.
